When is Thanksgiving break in Florida? Any school rain makeup days? Thanksgiving is fast approaching, which means the burning question in the minds of kids around Florida — and their parents — is: "When is Thanksgiving break?"
 For every Florida county, schools will be closed for at least the entire week of Thanksgiving, which falls on Nov. 26.
 A couple of counties have tacked on an extra day, starting the holiday this Friday, Nov. 20, or extending it a day into Monday, Nov. 30.
 Advertisement Advertisement Restock school supplies at Amazon 
 As of Nov. 16, no county affected by the historic rainfall earlier in November has changed its calendar to make up for the days lost when schools were closed due to flooding.
 "We recognize that many families have already made plans, especially with the break only a few weeks away," said Kyra Schafte, executive director of strategic communications and marketing with the Indian River County school district, via email Nov. 6.
 When is Thanksgiving this year?
 Thanksgiving is celebrated on the fourth Thursday in November.
 This year, the date falls on Nov. 26th.
 Is Thanksgiving a federal or Florida state holiday?
 Thanksgiving is both a federal holiday and a Florida state holiday .
 Will counties schedule makeup days after historic rainfall in November?
 Schools in several counties were closed for one to four days in early November due to the historic rainfall. As of Nov. 16, no makeup days have been planned.
 Advertisement Advertisement Brevard: Hasn't been determined as of yet, according to a school representative.
 DeSoto: We've reached out for any calendar changes.
 Glades: No makeup day will be used after flooding closed schools one day, according to a school representative.
 Hardee: We've reached out for any calendar changes.
 Indian River: "Thanksgiving break remains scheduled for Nov. 23 through 27. We recognize that many families have already made plans, especially with the break only a few weeks away," said Schafte said.
 Martin: At this time, no decision has been made regarding a makeup day, according to post on district website Nov. 5
 Okeechobee: A school representative said there will be no change to the current calendar.
 St. Lucie: We've reached out for any calendar changes.

 Thanksgiving falls on Thursday, Nov. 26. Here is when Florida school districts will observe a Thanksgiving break:

 Why aren't school calendars the same for all Florida counties?
 The decision on what days schools should be closed is made by individual school districts.
 Advertisement Advertisement Florida school districts develop their academic calendars with input from a variety of sources, including staff, families and calendar committees .
 The final decision is made by each county's school board.
 What other state holidays are coming this year in Florida?
 Remaining state holidays this year in Florida are:
 Thanksgiving Day: Thursday, Nov. 26
 Friday after Thanksgiving, Friday, Nov. 27
 Christmas Day: Friday, Dec. 25
 What are remaining federal holidays in 2026?
 Remaining federal holidays this year are:
 Thanksgiving Day: Thursday, Nov. 26
 Christmas Day: Friday, Dec. 25
 How many days of school are required in Florida?
 Districts in Florida must have at least 180 school days for students.
 Districts try to get roughly 90 instructional days in each semester and aim to finish the first semester before winter break, the St. Johns County School District said.
